Physical_Meaning: Thickness of solid pure crystalline ice (rho_i = 917 kg/m^3) with all firn pore space removed
Glaciological_Role: Primary dynamic state variable governing ice mass and momentum divergence
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: ALREADY in ice-equivalent units in BedMachine. DO NOT subtract FAC from BedMachine thickness.

Physical_Meaning: Physical vertical depth from snow surface down to bedrock including firn air pore spaces
Glaciological_Role: Required for true geometric aspect ratio W/H and radar travel-time comparison
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: Derived by adding firn air. Do not confuse with solid ice thickness H.

Physical_Meaning: Total depth of air pore space in firn column above solid ice pore close-off
Glaciological_Role: Accounts for firn compaction and altimetric surface elevation elevation bias
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: Prescribed structural state variable. Ingested once from BedMachine. Never subtracted twice.

Physical_Meaning: Elevation of solid bedrock or sub-shelf bathymetry above EIGEN-6C4 geoid
Glaciological_Role: Governs gravitational driving stress slope and Archimedean flotation condition
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: Continuous across grounding line. Negative in marine sectors (z_b < 0).

Physical_Meaning: Hypothetical surface elevation if firn layer were compressed to pure solid ice
Glaciological_Role: Used in driving stress balance if firn air gradient is neglected
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: Depressed below physical snow surface by FAC. Equal to BedMachine 'surface' variable.

Physical_Meaning: True physical top-of-snow surface elevation above EIGEN-6C4 geoid
Mathematical_Definition: s_geom = z_b + H + FAC = surface_BM + firn_BM
Glaciological_Role: Evaluated against satellite laser/radar altimetry and optical DEMs
Double_Subtraction_Precaution: If using physical snow surface s_geom, calculate H = s_geom - z_b - FAC. If using surface_BM, H = surface_BM - z_b.
